system.mark.title: What you changed: {parts}
system.view.custom_tip: Same stages, only what you changed
system.note.project: This map is for this project only. Settings that differ from global are marked 'Changed'.
system.note.flow: Large cards are the path a message takes. Small chips are systems and files that run alongside it.
system.detail.tip: Draw every system and link on one screen
system.feat.tip: Show enforced (solid) and advisory (dashed) feature counts on each card
system.legend: Values, files and features you changed. Anything unmarked is a default ({path}).
system.fcnote.instr: Guidance text for the model. It is only asked to follow it, so it can slip (advisory).
system.fcnote.deny: Deny lines in RULES. Code blocks them right before they run (enforced).
system.fcnote.folder: One folder inside features is one feature. Text is advisory; deny lines and monitoring files are enforced by code. Use the switch to turn it on or off.
system.fcnote.skill: A SKILL.md procedure. The model reads and follows it when needed (advisory).
system.fcnote.ext: Code the harness loads. Hooks block or change calls and tool runs (enforced).
system.fcnote.schedule: A timer that sends a sentence to the assistant at a set time.
system.fcnote.monitor: A check that runs a command on a schedule without calling the model and only reports changes.
system.fcnote.channel: Login keep-alive and monitoring tied to each work channel.
system.fcnote.gateway: Features built into the gateway code.
system.fcnote.external: Connections to outside services like Discord, mail (zele) and the browser (Aside).
system.fcnote.web: Home cards, sidebar pins and routines in ~/.dotz/custom. The bot makes them as files and they show up without a restart.
system.ext.label: {name} extensions
system.ext.note: Code {name} actually loads ({dirs}). Hooks block or change calls and tool runs (enforced).
system.dup.code: The same job is also written as code (enforced): {names}
system.dup.text: The same job is also written as text (advisory): {names}
system.fbadge.title: Features working here: {e} enforced · {a} advisory
system.sw.scope_tip: {scope} · The switch can also request a change to the shipped file
system.sw.req_shipped: Edit {repo} in the shipped repo directly (enabled: {on}). This changes it for all users.
system.sw.req_override: Override with the same id in {where}: copy {repo} into that folder and set enabled: {on}. Do not touch the shipped repo files.
system.str.enforced_tip: Code, hooks or deny lines block or run it
system.str.advisory_tip: Text that asks the model to follow it
system.origin.personal_tip: A feature that exists only in your files and settings (~/.dotz, the harness extension folder)
system.origin.shipped_tip: A feature that ships by default
system.flist.sup: Gray-filled cards (enforced) are what code blocks or runs; outlined cards (advisory) are text that asks the model to follow it.
system.pj.diff_tip: Number of values that differ from the global default
system.pj.head: Projects · {n}
system.pj.sup_some: Sessions tied to work channels and the home channel.
system.pj.sup_none: No sessions are tied to a work channel or the home channel yet.
system.pj.dirty.title: Unsaved changes
system.pj.dirty.body: The open item has unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?
system.pj.ask.ph: Describe the change you want for this project
system.with.head: Runs alongside · {n}
system.set.ro_note: This is security or connection info, so it can't be changed here.
system.fe.req_unchanged: The file content is unchanged. Edit the file yourself as the note says. Applies: {when}
system.fe.req_big: The change is large, so the diff is left out (+{add} -{del} lines). Changed places (original line numbers): {spans}. Open the file, check it and edit it as the note says.
system.fe.req_big_more: The change is large, so the diff is left out (+{add} -{del} lines). Changed places (original line numbers): {spans} and {n} more. Open the file, check it and edit it as the note says.
system.fe.stat_big: Too much changed for a diff, so only the changed line ranges are sent. Say in the note what you are changing
system.fe.len_cap: {n} chars (the first {cap} go into the startup instructions)
